could_two_workers_race_before_this_gate.why: nothing recorded that a worker looked at a job, so two processes both classified every job and neither could tell. It did not matter while the classification wrote nothing.

the_worker_that_already_existed.its_own_docstring: a dry-run worker is not a worker. It is the shape a worker would have, exercised against jobs that cannot run.
the_worker_that_already_existed.what_it_is: a pure function that classifies a list of jobs

why_a_new_table_was_required.contrast_with_gate_156: Gate 156 needed no migration because nf_opportunity_sources already carried the scheduling columns. There is no equivalent for a lease.
why_a_new_table_was_required.why_it_does_not_fit: its check_status vocabulary is scheduled/running/succeeded/succeeded_with_warnings/failed/canceled, beside opportunities_seen_count and accepted_count. That is the lifecycle of a check that happened. Writing a lease there would assert a check ran when nothing did.
